If all goes well, we should be able to punch through quickly and take out the High Priestess. As for you, get in there and start cracking skulls. Meet my second, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, near the steps to the shrine after you've caused some trouble.

Winds guide you, $c.

complete.text: We fought hard to get this far but it isn't over yet.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Al'Aketh Guardians, $2oa Al'Aketh Spiritcallers, and $3oa Al'Aketh Blademasters, then report to Hyusaa Quickbreeze at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.

complete.text: We are as ready as we'll ever be.

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist in the Gustberry Lowlands.

accept.text:
Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition.

I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years.

Winds be with you, $n.

complete.text:
I'm pleased to hear that we have High Elder Shadowsong's blessing for our expedition. Now that the cult has been defeated and preparations have been made, I think it's finally time.

Muln has worked diligently to help us get stable skycutter transport going between Zephras Isle and a place called Mulgore, where the Earthen Ring make their home. We've been doing test voyages and some of our people are already waiting on the other side.

objectives.text: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

accept.text:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.

objectives.text: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.

accept.text:
Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain.

High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.

complete.text:
<Talaanis Shadowsong listens intently as you tell him of what transpired above the Shrine of Akir, and of Ayessa's plan to leave Zephras Isle.>

I need to reflect on this further, but looking at the upside, we have rid ourselves of Lorthuna and deprived the cult of their leader. Our home has not been invaded yet and on the timeline of elemental gods, it could be years... decades even, before Al'Akir deigns to turn his attention to us.

There is much to fear now, but much to celebrate as well.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

accept.text:
Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left.

I'll stay here and watch your back.

complete.text: <Valennia looks gravely wounded.>

objectives.text: Speak with Valennia Stormfist inside the inner sanctum at the Shrine of Akir.

accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Practice Lock, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

objectives.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Potion of Demonslaying, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>

objectives.text: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.

accept.text:
A key tenent of being a paladin is the pursuit of divinity. This is not the pursuit of godhood, but merely the pursuit of good itself, for good's sake. We've all arrived at this place due to tragedy of one form or another, and it would be easy to lose that grace that defined us as paladins in life.

Go to the Undercity and seek out Tanis Alderwood in the Trade Quarter. They are in need, and they could benefit greatly from some grace.

complete.text: You... you are a $c? Please, do not hurt me. I-I know I'm not supposed to be panhandling. I have no quarrel with you or your order. Leave me be, I beg you!

objectives.text: Speak to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.

accept.text:
Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?

Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance. 

It's my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.

complete.text: This is very kind of you, $c. Very kind indeed.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.

progress.text: I hope that this is no imposition upon you, goodly $c.

accept.text: I don't know why you'd go out of your way to help me, but I appreciate it. If someone sent you my way, tell them I appreciate them too. You'll always have a friend in Tanis Alderwood, $c.

objectives.text: Return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep.

accept.text:
The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him.

We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.

complete.text:
We could try and send peacekeepers to directly engage the cult forces, but we would not fare well against them in open battle.

We are going to need a different approach.

objectives.text: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong and observe the conversation.

accept.text:
Humans are not our only adversary within the Riverglades, $n, nor are they our most dire.

A cult known as the Twilight's Hammer has begun a campaign against those they deem heretics in the eyes of their twisted gods. The ravaged remains of a human settlement to the west are but the first to fall to their conquest. No doubt Rog'mar will be next.

We cannot afford to let them establish a foothold so close to our doorstep. Go to this so-called Sunnyglade and thin their numbers.

complete.text: Excellent work, $N. With their numbers diminished, we can seek the source of the Twilight Hammer's unprecedented expansion.

objectives.text: Defeat $1oa Twilight Raiders and $2oa Twilight Neophytes within Sunnyglade for Tran'gul in Rog'mar.

complete.text: These missives tell of disturbing news, $N. These are no mere stragglers aimlessly biting at our heels like rabid animals. The Twilight's Hammer is here for a reason. They are searching for something.

progress.text: Slay the Twilight Shadowmancers and search their corpses. With luck, they will have the information we seek.

accept.text:
The Twilight's Hammer are here for more than simple chaos, $n. They appear to be digging throughout the Riverglades for something. As for what they are searching for, I cannot say. A source of power, of course, but what that is still eludes me.

Their zealots may not be willing to divulge their secrets, but they must have someone doing the digging for them. These are the ones you are to question. Return to Sunnyglade and 'convince' one of their miners to talk. We must get to the bottom of this.

complete.text: Ouch! Ouch! No more hit! What you want?

objectives.text: Convince a Twilight's Hammer miner in Sunnyglade to divulge their secrets.

accept.text:
Greetings, young skyborne. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of Turak Runetotem. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.

complete.text:
A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?

Well, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

objectives.text: Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.$B$BAs for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.

complete.text: Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young $c.

objectives.text: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

accept.text:
You know the Eastsea crew? Real unsavory bunch, and that's coming from the guy running a place called "Powderfuse Port".

They're destructive, bloodthirsty, and, worst of all, cutting into my bottom line. They steal cargo, and sink ships, both of which end up costing me the big bucks!

We gotta take down their whole operation, starting with the ones closest to here. You can find 'em along the beaches to the north.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Eastsea Buccaneers and $2oa Eastsea Musketeers along the Eastwind Shore, north of Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.

objectives.text: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.

accept.text:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!

objectives.text: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.

accept.text:
Hey, bub. Got a package that needs to go to an old friend of mine. Whatever you do--

DO NOT OPEN THE PACKAGE!

Take this--carefully--to Friz Frazzlespark across the seas over to our sister port in the Riverglades. And before you ask, no I would not suggest swimming. Didn't work out so well for the last guy. Oh, and don't tilt it, shake it, or make any sudden movements.

I recommend heading east to Steamwheedle Port. The ship from there usually provides safe passage.

Best of luck to ya!

complete.text:
A package from my old pal, Fizzgrimble? Just what I've been waitin' for!

You didn't shake this, tilt it or make any sudden movements while carrying it, did you?

Would you mind turning around while I take a look inside? I wouldn't want you spoiling the surprise.

objectives.text: Deliver Fizzgrimble's Mysterious Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

complete.text:
It's not every day we get a visitor from Powderfuse Port. That's no small trek!

I'm guessin' if you came all the way out here on your own you ain't in much caravannin' needs, eh? Who sent you, then? Friz?

There's no way I'm lettin' you into my town without me checkin' your cargo first.

<The wharfmaster clears his throat deliberately as he maintains eye contact with you.>

No. Way.

progress.text: Shipment from Powderfuse Port, huh? And from Friz no less. Good luck with that, buddy. You gotta wake up pretty early in the mornin' to pull that one over me!

complete.text:
So Ulka survived and sent you in here after me? You found her surrounded by bodies? Ulka is a credit to the Kor'kron and I will see to it that she gets a field promotion when we are done here.

We can't leave yet though. Our mission is not yet complete.

accept.text:
I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan.

Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand $Gboy:girl;, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know.

Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.

complete.text: Welcome, welcome friend! You here to participate in the notorious Gadgetzan Arena?

objectives.text: Speak with Fizbuz Mithril in Gadgetzan.

complete.text:
You say there is evil in Shadowvale? I admit, I am not surprised. The forest folk were an odd lot, and they did not care for visitors. Some believe the Whispering Forest itself is cursed, and the elixir distilled from its roots carries that same curse...

...but enough of superstition and rumors, $N. Thank you for the elixirs. Here, take this as payment.

progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?

accept.text:
Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings? That's a joke, right? His slackjaw champion didn't even last two minutes in the arena! That loser didn't earn a single copper.

It's none of my business, pal, but if I were you I'd skedaddle back to Steamwheedle Port. While you're standin' here talkin' to me, that little rat Tazzik is probably tryin' to hop the next ship outta here.

complete.text:
Okay you win! I bet everythin' I had on those fights to pay off Friz and I lost it all!

But I can't give back her stuff. You gotta help me out here!

objectives.text: Confront Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

accept.text:
Your timin' couldn't be better, friend. I was just on my way to collect my shipment from the Bloodsail Buccaneers. They're good friends of mine. Always happy to supply anything Friz is willin' to pay for.

But, ahem, just in case, it couldn't hurt for you to be my liaison. A good caravaneer knows it doesn't hurt to show off a little muscle. Just as a deterrent, of course.

They said they left my stuff in a chest on the hill outside of town for safekeepin'. Why don't you take a look for me, eh?

complete.text:
Venture Co? And the trunk was empty?

Those rotten cheats stole my money! I knew dealin' with those good-for-nothin' pirates was bad for business! Nobody goes back on a deal with Ruzzgot and gets away with it.

objectives.text: Find the Bloodsail Trunk outside of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

accept.text:
I already spent good coin on that crate. We ain't just going to let them have it!

You want your shipment? Go to the Venture Co's camp up north and find out who's responsible for this backstabbin'! This ain't about money anymore, $n. This is about justice! And maybe a little about the money.

complete.text: <A grease covered tome filled with notes of business deals between the Venture Co. and its associates.>

objectives.text: Find the Venture Co. Ledger in the Venture Co. Camp near Lake Nezferiti in Stranglethorn.

accept.text: <The ledger contains a log of each of Ruzzgot's deliveries. The final note marks the heist a success and Ruzzgot's valuables collected by a nearby Venture Co. agent. The goods must still be with him.>

complete.text:
That's more like it! If a caravaneer can't be trusted with a delivery, what else does he have? 

Say, you don't need help shipping this to Powderfuse Port, do ya?

objectives.text: Kill the Venture Co. Agent and take back Ruzzgot's Shipment for him in Booty Bay.

progress.text: Well? You find out who took my stuff?

accept.text:
Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself.

Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.

objectives.text: Return to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

accept.text:
The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon.

When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. 

Banu-Alah, $n.

complete.text:
More adventurers from Zephras, I see. Wonderful. The winds surely favor us! It's going to take us some time to get ourselves established here, so you may want to take some time to explore this new land.

Azeroth is an exciting new world, but it's also a dangerous world. You'd do well to prepare yourself for this new adventure by familiarizing yourself with the lands nearby.

objectives.text: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alaana Stormwalker when you arrive.

accept.text:
It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival.

The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar.

Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, $n.

objectives.text: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

accept.text:
<Wharfmaster Steamfizzle inspects the coin you offered him.>

Whoa-ho! Ol' Friz sure is training the new generation right. Apologies for the delay, $Gsir:ma'am;. You're here to deliver a crate to someone in town, right? I don't know anythin' about that, but if I did, I'd go talk with Tazzik on the dock. He seems to be interested in things like that.

But be quick about it though, yeah? Don't need folks gettin' the wrong idea, ya know.

complete.text:
Hello beautiful! Friz sure delivers, doesn't she? And look at the quality of these.

What? Hey don't look at me. I didn't tell you to spend all your gold breaking the law. Far as I'm concerned, this shipment's been cleared by customs. Friz's money on the other hand... that might be a problem.

objectives.text: Deliver Friz's Secret Stash to Tazzik in Steamwheedle Port.

progress.text: Uck, you don't have to tell me where you're from. I can smell Powderfuse Port all over you.

accept.text: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>

complete.text:
Strange scroll, you say? Yeah, this looks like some top-grade magic. The GOOD stuff. Thanks for bringin' it here, friend. Take this as a reward for your time.

Now, let me just see about translating this mess and getting it transcribed into my records...

objectives.text: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.

accept.text: <Faint magic emanates from the scrap of scroll. The language is unfamiliar, though you intuit that it is not dangerous. Most would find the parchment useless, but there may be a unique collector that may find some use out of it.>

complete.text: A magical scroll? Boy is it my lucky day! I'll just copy these runes over to my work and you'll get a front-row seat to the dawn of a new legendary engineer. Just don't get too close, I don't want to have to cut you any royalties... I mean I don't want you to get hurt.

objectives.text: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.

accept.text:
Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more.

Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think.

You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.

complete.text: <The ogre lies dead, surrounded by a ring of dark runes. It appears to have been overwhelmed by the powers of the Twilight Hammer's ritual.>

objectives.text: Find missing ogres in the caves beneath Sunnyglade for Clubtoe.

accept.text:
Me done with Twilight. Clubtoe free ogre now.

Me go find Clugfist. He biggestest ogre Clubtoe ever see. He leave Twilight. Take many friends with him. It Clubtoe's turn. Me join free ogres. They go to the hills. Clubtoe miss hills. No more smashing rocks. Maybe you come sometime?

Me stay here till coast is clear. You take Chogg'Zac's heads back to friends. Well. Maybe one head. Me get one too. Fair trade.

complete.text:
Well, well. Looks like that cave was not our only surprise.

You managed to convince one of the Twilight's Hammer ogres to defect? And he mentioned others of his kind? We must act on this immediately.

objectives.text: Deliver the head of Chogg to Tran'gul in Rog'mar.

progress.text: So, the Twilight's Hammer found something in the earth? You were right to banish this evil, $N. If it interests those fanatics, it's not to be trusted.

accept.text:
Clearly these wayward ogres are no friends to the Twilight's Hammer. We orcs have an honored history fighting alongside ogres, and it may be time to call upon those old alliances again. And this head may be the key.

There have been reports of ogre activity in the hills far to the north. If this Clubtoe is to be believed, that must be where this clan calls home. Go to their stronghold and offer this trophy as a token of our friendship. With luck, they will listen to your proposal before they step on you.

objectives.text: Deliver Chogg's head to the ogre city to the north.

accept.text:
Clubtoe friends... dead? Why?

This Chogg'Zac fault! Dey say they make ogres strong! They lie!!

No more smashing rocks! Tiny creature help Clubtoe smash Chogg'zac stupid heads instead!

complete.text:
Tiny $r kill Chogg'Zac?

<Clubtoe lets out a triumphant bellow that echoes through the caves.>

Clubtoe done smashing rock for tinies! Clubtoe done losing friends! Me Twilight no more!

objectives.text: Kill Chogg'Zac in the Sunnyglade cave and collect their heads for Clubtoe.

progress.text: No more kill friends! Chogg'Zac die today!

accept.text:
My good axe arm is broken and most of my elites are dead. The honor of the Kor'kron rests with you now.

We were sent here to extract a prisoner, but not just any prisoner... We are here for the King of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. We intercepted information that he was being held here and our Warchief commanded us to bring him back to Orgrimmar alive. The presence of black dragons... complicates things.

I need you to press on and find Wrynn. I will wait for you here while you search for him.

complete.text: <It seems that there's a greater force pulling the strings than the lesser dragon you just slew. It's time to go and inform Commander Folkar of what you've learned.>

objectives.text: Look for King Varian Wrynn in Alcaz Prison.

accept.text:
I'm tellin' ya, I can't pay Friz back! I got nothin' left but the shirt off my back!

Why are you lookin' at me like that...

objectives.text: Bring Tazzik's Sweaty Shirt to Friz Frazzlespark in Powderfuse Port.

accept.text:
Thrall needs to know what happened here. I will meet up with Ulka and see to it that he is fit to travel before returning to Orgrimmar, so I am trusting you to bring this information to the warchief in my stead.

Go now, soldier of the Horde. Tell our warchief what fate befell Varian Wrynn.

complete.text:
It pains me to hear that most of Folkar's Kor'kron were lost to bring us this information, but I am thankful that we have it.

For now we will use this knowledge to strengthen our positions across Azeroth. Varian was an honorable man and I do not celebrate his passing, but anything that weakens the Alliance strengthens the Horde. We must seize any advantage we can get.

The Horde owes you a debt, $N. Please, accept this as a token of my gratitude for your aid.

objectives.text: Bring word of Varian Wrynn's fate to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

accept.text:
<This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more.

These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.>

complete.text:
Tiny $r not turn purple! Hurray!

But... where friends?

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Empowered Brutes and $2oa Twilight Ritualists then return to Clubtoe in Sunnyglade.

accept.text:
Me hate smashing rock. All day me smash. Chogg'Zac say so. He big boss. Say we smash tinies, but now we work for tinies. That stupid.

Why smash rock? Me no know. Find shiny light in rocks. Chogg'Zac like shiny, me guess. Are you here for shiny light too? Others won't like that. They really like light. They draw pictures with it.

Clubtoe not get it. Light make Clubtoe feel sick. Me hate light. Me want SMASH shiny pictures! But Chogg'Zac be mad. Squish Clubtoe. That bad. But someone should.

complete.text: Clubtoe feel better already! You smash lots of shiny pictures? Were others mad?

objectives.text: Destroy $1oa Twilight Ritual Circles found throughout the caves underneath Sunnyglade.

accept.text:
My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!

If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

objectives.text: Find Ardin Grassman in the Excavation Sites.

complete.text: Llana must be wondering where those grass seeds are that I promised I'd have my husband bring back! It comforts me to know she's as concerned as I am. It must be something about the excavation site itself that we're both sensing.

progress.text: Heya! Have you had a chance to take care of those blasted pirates yet? I have a crew standing by to go plunder-- er, explore the troll ruins.

complete.text:
I can't thank you enough! I will be able to sleep better knowing there are fewer of those Saltseers around.

I know the Baron also appreciates your service. Here's your bounty.

accept.text:
Now that we've claimed the head of the tarnished commander, I need you to deliver it to the Undercity. Sylvanas Windrunner mistrusts us greatly, and all but openly disparages us.

Deliver Rudolph Gelhardt's head to the Dark Lady. Show her that we tend to our own house and are devoted to the prosperity of the forsaken.

complete.text:
I don't doubt Danitha's sincerity and desire to earn a place for your kind amongst the Forsaken. However, I suspect that this isn't the last time we'll see one of your brothers and sisters go mad and turn the light against their own people.

There may come a time when I decide that tolerating your misbegotten order is no longer in the best interests of the Forsaken. I suggest you continue to serve your people diligently.

We will be watching.

objectives.text: Bring the head of Rudolph Gelhardt to Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.

progress.text: Why are you addressing me, $c?

complete.text:
Dese very heavy! Now me smash good rocks with heavy rocks!

<Hamur crushes the rocks you collected into dust, leaving only the weightstones.>

Dese good for smashing. Here you go.

progress.text: Smith tinies turn rocks into heavy rock. Genius. Maybe you buy from dem?

complete.text: I hope you made them suffer, $c!

progress.text: Blood and thunder!

complete.text:
I thank you for bringing me these bandanas. There is no doubt in my mind that they are Defias Brotherhood masks. We had our suspicions that they were the ones operating the prison on Alcaz, but this confirms it.

I will inform Thrall of this.

progress.text: What is this, $c?

accept.text:
Wow! That was impressive. The way you took down that dragon was really something!

While you are here... do you think you might be able to help me get out of this ball and chain?

If he hasn't fled or been killed already, the torturer they call 'The Questioner' should have the keys to these shackles. Get the key from that sadist and bring it to me.

I promise that I'll make it well worth your while if you do.

complete.text:
It feels good to get those shackles off. I can't even remember how long it's been. Now I just need an Inn, a shower, a shave... and the feel of a suit.

Maybe a haircut, too. Feeling a little grungy.

objectives.text: Recover the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner in Alcaz Prison.

progress.text: What do you say we cut the chit-chat and focus on getting me out of here!

accept.text:
I told you that I'd make it worth your while to free me. I don't have any gold for you, but I have something better.

Take this. It will help you find a treasure more valuable than gold. Do what you want with it, but if anyone asks you where you got it, tell them that the person who gave it to you died. 

Tell them he was vaporized by dragonfire... blown out to sea.

objectives.text: Use the note provided by Mason Connery to find his hidden treasure.

accept.text: <The King is dead--killed in an escape attempt just before the Naga attacked. Many Kor'kron died to learn this news, but this knowledge could shake the Alliance to its core. You need to return to Commander Folkar and tell him what you've learned as quickly as possible.>

complete.text:
So Wrynn is dead then... 

I will mourn the warriors who died here, but their deaths were not in vain. We know more than we did before, and knowledge of this kind is of value. Stormwind--nay, the Alliance itself has never been more vulnerable and that knowledge is powerful.

Thank you for your service to the Horde. For my part, I owe you my life as well. That is a debt that I will not soon forget. I'll make my way out of here and see to Sergeant Ulka on my own.

objectives.text: Report back to Commander Folkar.

complete.text: Thank you for your aid, $c. If we do not wish to see Lordaeron's history repeat itself, we've got to be vigilant when threats like this spring up.

Thank you. This should slow the efforts of the Scourge in this area. I suspect the denizens of Tirisfal will be pulling these crystals out of the ground for years, but removing the most conspicuous of them can only help.

progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.

accept.text:
You've done a great thing for the cause of the Argent Dawn here today, and I thank you. I don't know how familiar you are with the fortress of Bandarion Keep, but my commander and I were headed that way to meet with the paladins that reside there. That was before we learned of the presence of the Cult of the Damned.

If you'd like to learn more about the Argent Dawn and our mission, seek out my commander at Bandarion Keep, to the northwest of here. I'll remain here to mop up the rest of this mess.

objectives.text: Meet Leonid Barthalomew at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.

accept.text:
Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!

objectives.text: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.

complete.text: This will do nicely. We've deprived our enemies of an important tool, and equipped ourselves with a powerful weapon to use against the Scourge.

progress.text: The Death's Head quilboar have been a constant thorn in our side for years, due in no small part to machinations of that accursed Lich.

accept.text:
Muln tells me that there is a location in the deepest depths of a place called Blackrock Mountain where the barrier between Azeroth and the elemental plane has been damaged, allowing a myriad of elemental creatures from the realm of the Firelands to escape into this reality, including giants as large as an Anchor Pylon!

I'd very much like to study any fragments of material that could be gathered from one of these creatures. Would you brave the Blackrock Depths and recover a sample for me?

objectives.text: Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.

accept.text:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been corrupted by dark and sinister magic. We do not know the full extent of the corruption and what impact it may have upon the elements in the area, but we hope to understand it better.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and prepare for a difficult battle.

objectives.text: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.

complete.text: Your actions show you are one who respects knowledge. The library is open for use in your studies.

They may not have looked like they were ready to make an assault on Grom'gol, but it was a risk we could not afford to make again.

For the Horde!

accept.text:
A merchant caravan took a wrong turn through the desert and got jumped by the Dunemaul ogres. Only reason they made it out alive is 'cause they tossed some cargo overboard to distract the brutes.

Must be this merchant's got friends with the nobs runnin' ships and zeppelins, 'cause now they want ME pickin' up what got lost.

I'm stuck here working. But if YOU see a nice shiny bangle while you're beatin' on ogres, I'll make it worth ya while.

objectives.text: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to recover a particularly shiny bangle bracelet lost near the Dunemaul ogre compound.

accept.text:
Pssst, wanna know somethin'? It's easier to make profit in a place like this than you think... it's all about knowing how to market! I've seen what these tech-heads do when they get their hands on something they think they can turn into a fuel cell.

Even better if it's still glowin' or sputtering steam.

Why don't we strike a deal? Bring back some of the parts that fall off their machines in the desert, and I'll kick you back a share of the coin I get from selling the salvage back to the junkers!

complete.text:
Solid haul, sandfoot. I'll run 'em through the crusher and sorter to get these off our shelves pronto!

Here, have some silver, go buy yourself a drink.

objectives.text: Quinn wants you to recover $1oa  pieces of Desert Debris and return to her in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: Don't worry about any labels that say hazardous or toxic... I'll shred those up and they'll be none the wiser!

complete.text:
Thank you, $c. I very much doubt I would have survived the journey or destination, considering the state you say Sunnyglade is in now.

This tome is exactly what I needed. I am happy to say all of the pages are here as well.

Perhaps I can learn a new trade in undeath. It would give me a skill to hone for the rest of my unlife, at least.

progress.text:
Ah, you have returned. Were you successful in recovering my family's tome? What state is Sunnyglade in?

The last time I laid eyes on my old town, it was being burnt to ash.

I joined the Stormwind army and traveled all the way up here to Lordaeron and died in the second war, so I never had a chance to return. I heard of efforts to rebuild Sunnyglade but I am not sure they ever were able to.

accept.text:
You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!

It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.

Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.

But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!

<Alessandro makes a shooing motion.>

complete.text:
Ah, marvelous! I had been waiting for Alessandro's potion to arrive. The last six he sent destabilized along the way, but you've made it just in time!

Here, take this for your effort. That is all for now, unless you have other business with me?

If not, remove yourself so I may continue my experiments unhindered.

objectives.text: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.

accept.text:
Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence.

We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound.

Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table.

Return to me when the deed is done.

complete.text:
Good work, soldier. I know you're not stationed with us, but we never turn away capable hands.

If they don't respond to THIS letter, we'll have to be more crude in our messaging.

We'll keep you on reserve for civilian interactions should the need arise again.

objectives.text: Place the Sealed Company Request you were given on the bookkeeping table within Hillsbrad's town hall.

accept.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!

objectives.text: Deliver the bottles of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in southeast Hillsbrad Foothills, and bring back a sack of their Homebrew Hops.

accept.text:
I came to Menethil Harbor from Auberdine, from the great tree Teldrassil, to recover a bloom of great import to my people.

My people's ship the Flying Osprey crashed here many moons ago, joined with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Among its cargo was the flower known as Nord'el--Bloom of the Heavens in your tongue--bloomed under a full moon at the peak of Mount Hyjal, our former home.

Please help me retrieve it! The wreckage is just south of the city, but it is inhabited by fierce murloc raiders!

complete.text:
It has survived! Oh, Elune be praised!

A thousand thanks, $N. If you are willing, I do have one more favor to ask of you...

objectives.text: Recover Nord'el for Sylessa Duskwhisper in Menethil Harbor.

progress.text: Have you been to the wreckage? It is a most somber sight.

accept.text:
Would you please deliver Nord'el to elder Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine?

The boat from here should be able to get you there swiftly.

I apologize for the request, I truly do. I remain fatigued from my journey here--and from fleeing those murloc devils when I first attempted to retrieve the sacred bloom!

complete.text:
The Nord'el survived? It cannot be... after all these years!

Our goddess is most wonderful indeed!

You have my thanks for delivering it here. It is a rare light in the dark times we have had of late, and a symbol of not only Elune's grace, but of the enduring will of our people to persevere without our immortality.

I will see to it that it is transported safely to Darnassus, so that it may be properly cultivated.

objectives.text:
Bring Nord'el to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine in Darkshore.

You recall Sylessa mentioning a boat in Menethil Harbor can take you there.

progress.text: I welcome you to Auberdine, $c. How may we be of aid to you in your travels?

accept.text:
In the Second War the Dragonmaw built a fleet where we now stand, intending to take Hillsbrad. They nearly succeeded!

They were routed by the red dragons, left to mere stragglers deep in the mountains. However, there has been a surge in activity in their encampment northeast of Menethil.

Dun Algaz is proof that they intend to march to war once again and retake this land. Find their attack plans, take note of any critical information, and destroy them. We need to know where they will strike next!

objectives.text: Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Keep wants you to destroy the 4 sets of Attack Plans in the Angerfang Encampment.

accept.text:
Certain alchemical recipes require ingredients sourced from, well, very dangerous places. And those are often just the base herbs! The other ingredients are even worse!

I need to make more antivenom before I can leave again. I swear everything in this marsh is venomous. It's like it runs through the land itself!

Can you help me? I'll need a venom gland from the spiders in Thelgen Rock to the far southeast. But it has to be unruptured, or too much venom will spill out before you can get here. Sorry!

objectives.text: Collect an Unruptured Stalker Gland from Thelgen Rock for Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor.

accept.text:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.

The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.

Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.

Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.

complete.text:
I've got what you need, pal! Stay awhile, spend some of that gold weighing down your pocket, and have a good time.

Welcome to the Salty Sailor Tavern!

objectives.text: Visit Nixxrax Fillamug in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in Stranglethorn.

accept.text:
Any experienced shaman who attempts to scry the elemental plane can tell you that there is a blip of sorts, a distortion that you feel as you cross over to the other realms of existence.

We have need of adventurers like yourself to help us better understand this disturbance. Take this Elemental Attractor. You will be able to extract motes of unstable magic with it from the most skilled spellcasters and other powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me these motes so that we may study them.

objectives.text: Bring $1oa Motes of Unstable Magic to Nuara Tremorhoof.

complete.text:
Thanks for delivering this, pal.

Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that! 

Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these Forsaken leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.

progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.

complete.text:
Most glorious indeed!

<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>

Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!

A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.

progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?

accept.text:
While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.

I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.

Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.

complete.text:
Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.

With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.

progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.

accept.text:
Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with Naxxramas.

Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.

Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.

complete.text: Well done--and quick, too! Now onto my favorite part...

objectives.text: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.

progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?

accept.text:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.

complete.text:
You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.

objectives.text: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.

progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
